_texte.Da. Orice produs din marketplace benefic: Yes. Every marketplace product benefits from the legal guarantee (at least 2 years under EU Directive 2019/771) plus the manufacturer's commercial warranty. The digital certificate is issued and archived automatically.
_texte.Dacă lucrarea prezintă defecte în termen: If the work shows defects within the warranty period, the customer opens a complaint on the platform. Darrin AI checks the before/after report and the documents, determines the partner's fault and starts the claims procedure. The partner fixes it or bears the cost from the workmanship policy.
_texte.Darrin AI alocă și virează sumele fiecăr: Darrin AI allocates and transfers the amounts to each participant within 7 working days at most. All automatic, into each partner's account.
